article.headline: Jazz take on the Suns on 4-game losing streak
article.description: Phoenix Suns (9-9, 11th in the Western Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (3-17, 14th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Jazz take on the Suns on 4-game losing streak
article.linkText: Jazz take on the Suns on 4-game losing streak
article.story: Phoenix Suns (9-9, 11th in the Western Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (3-17, 14th in the Western Conference) Salt Lake City; Sunday, 5 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Utah looks to break its four-game losing streak when the Jazz take on Phoenix. The Jazz have gone 3-15 against Western Conference teams. Utah has a 1-14 record against teams above .500. The Suns have gone 7-9 against Western Conference opponents. Phoenix ranks seventh in the Western Conference shooting 35.8% from 3-point range. The Jazz score 107.8 points per game, 7.1 fewer points than the 114.9 the Suns give up. The Suns average 113.6 points per game, 2.0 fewer than the 115.6 the Jazz give up to opponents. The two teams square off for the second time this season. The Suns defeated the Jazz 111-101 in their last meeting on Nov. 21. Devin Booker led the Suns with 23 points, and Darryn Peterson led the Jazz with 20 points. TOP PERFORMERS: Peterson is averaging 16.2 points and four assists for the Jazz. Keyonte George is averaging 18.1 points over the last 10 games. Booker is averaging 24.9 points and 5.4 assists for the Suns. Jalen Green is averaging 13.4 points over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Jazz: 2-8, averaging 109.4 points, 44.4 rebounds, 25.8 assists, 6.8 steals and 4.4 blocks per game while shooting 46.9% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 113.3 points per game. Suns: 6-4, averaging 114.5 points, 42.1 rebounds, 26.9 assists, 6.7 steals and 3.0 blocks per game while shooting 47.1% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 112.0 points. INJURIES: Jazz: Lauri Markkanen: out (wrist), Jaren Jackson Jr.: out (knee), Mo Bamba: out (illness). Suns: Mark Williams: out (shoulder). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
